<thought>Search for retrosynthetic templates that break an aryl halide bond and form a C‑C double bond, which corresponds to a Heck coupling that could connect 4‑iodoanisole with 4‑methoxystyrene to give the target 4,4'‑dimethoxystilbene.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
